meta.description: Knowledge graph for the ManiSkill PickCube task: a Franka Panda (7 arm joints + parallel gripper) grasps a red cube (2cm half-size) and lifts/moves it so the cube centre reaches a 3D goal position (a floating target). Consumed by the P4-LLM reasoning + prescription components to ground failure analysis and the prescribed correction config (cube_init_pose + goal_pose) the expert must solve. Workspace coordinates are world-frame metres; prescriptions MUST stay inside the stated ranges or the expert is unreliable and the round is wasted.
meta.control_mode: pd_joint_pos (policy acts in rel_joint_pos = 7 joint deltas + 1 gripper command)

properties.role: the cube to grasp and move to the goal
the cube centre must reach within goal_thresh of this point
properties.is_floating: goal z can be above the table (a lift target)

properties.role: grasps the cube on opposing faces; top-down approach
properties.approach_matters: must align over the cube and close before lifting

properties.note: cube spawns flat on the table; only z-rotation varies
goal may be on the table (z=0.02) or lifted up to z=0.32

properties.expert_action: panda motion planner → grasp/lift/move-to-goal (recorded as the same 8-dim demo)

properties.description: Gripper closes without securing the cube (off-centre approach, fingers slip, or never reaches the cube).
Cube is grasped then slips/falls during lift or transport before reaching the goal.
Cube is carried but released/stopped outside goal_thresh of the goal (especially for high/lifted goals).
Cube reaches the goal but the arm/cube keeps moving, so the static check fails.
Episode reaches the step horizon without success (hesitation, oscillation, slow approach).
close the gripper on the cube
raise the cube off the table
carry the cube to the 3D goal and hold static

reasoning_implications.missed_grasp: Prescribe a cube_init_pose with a clean top-down approach (well inside ws_cube, away from the workspace edge) so the demo teaches reliable centred grasping — the prerequisite for all later phases.
reasoning_implications.dropped: Prescribe a config with a moderate goal height so the demo teaches a stable lift/carry; avoid extreme goal z until grasping+lifting is reliable.
reasoning_implications.missed_goal: Prescribe a goal closer to the cube (shorter transport) or a lower goal z so the demo teaches a controlled approach that stops within goal_thresh.
reasoning_implications.not_static: Prescribe a config that ends with the cube held at the goal so the demo teaches a settled, static hold (no residual motion at release).
reasoning_implications.timeout: Prescribe a config with cube and goal well inside the reliable workspace and a short, direct grasp-lift-move corridor (no oscillation).
reasoning_implications.workspace_constraint: Every prescribed config MUST keep cube_xyz within x[-0.10,0.10] y[-0.10,0.10] z=0.02 and goal_xyz within x[-0.10,0.10] y[-0.10,0.10] z[0.02,0.32] and tcp within x[-0.35,0.35] y[-0.35,0.35] z[0.02,0.40]; out-of-range poses are infeasible (the expert cannot solve them) and waste the round.
reasoning_implications.non_emptiness: A failure is present, so the prescription MUST be a concrete, fully-specified config (non-empty cube_xyz, cube_zrot, goal_xyz). Never emit an empty prescription.
